per share on the company&#8217;s common stock</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">PHOENIX, October 28, 2026</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> -- Honeywell Aerospace (Nasdaq&#58; HONA) today announced results for the third quarter and declared its first quarterly dividend. The company also raised its full-year 2026 pro forma standalone adjusted earnings per share</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> and second half 2026 free cash flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> guidance ranges, maintained its full-year organic</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> sales outlook, and narrowed its full-year pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> guidance range. </font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">&#8220;Honeywell Aerospace delivered results above our expectations in its first quarter as a standalone company, increasing sales and adjusted EBIT sequentially and year over year as we accelerate investments to drive greater output and better serve our customers. Demand for our solutions remains robust with 9% orders growth over the last 12 months,&#8221; said Jim Currier, Chief Executive Officer of Honeywell Aerospace. &#8220;We are seeing encouraging signs from pacing suppliers as we deepen our commitment to enduring partnerships. This progress, combined with ongoing qualification of additional material sources, positions us for higher sales and output growth in 2027 and beyond.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Initial dividend declaration </font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace&#8217;s Board of Directors has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share of its common stock. The dividend is payable on December 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 13, 2026. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Currier added, &#8220;The Board&#8217;s decision to declare a regular dividend underscores the visibility into our durable free cash flow growth in the years ahead. Paying a competitive, growing dividend is a key component of our capital allocation strategy designed to deliver substantial shareholder value while maintaining financial flexibility and a strong investment-grade credit rating.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Recent Honeywell Aerospace highlights</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">Year to date, the company has secured more than $20 billion in new wins (estimated lifetime value) supported by the following announcements&#58;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">The U.S. Air Force advanced Honeywell Aerospace&#8217;s SkyShot 1600 engine, which is designed to meet all mission-critical performance parameters for collaborative combat aircraft and unmanned aircraft systems, into Preliminary Design Review as part of its Autonomous Collaborative Platform program. </font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">Honeywell Aerospace secured over $2 billion in new awards to provide its advanced navigation and RF systems for several missiles and munitions programs, including some initial contracts on platforms prioritized by the Munitions Acceleration Council. </font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">The City of Phoenix Aviation Department signed an agreement with Honeywell Aerospace to study how to translate the company&#8217;s Surface Alert (SURF-A) technology to ground vehicle operators on tarmacs, taxiways, and runways at three local airports, including Phoenix Sky Harbor International.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="height:42.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div 3Q26 Results - 2</font></div></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">The company announced a 300,000 square foot expansion of its Tempe, Arizona manufacturing facility, expected to open in late 2028. The new facility adds capacity, lean manufacturing, automation, and supply-chain resilience to support current Control Systems production, recent wins, and next generation platforms.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.31pt">Honeywell Aerospace presented an update on its supply chain transformation at a September investor conference. Key messages from the presentation included root causes and actions underway for the constraints from a small number of mechanical suppliers currently limiting output growth.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Summary financial results </font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace sales for the third quarter increased 2% on a reported and organic&#185; basis year over year. Backlog grew to $19.3 billion at quarter end, up 12% from the prior year, and trailing twelve-months orders were up 9%, led by Defense and Space. spin-off is calculated using 317 million common shares based on the shares of Honeywell Aerospace common stock outstanding as of the spin-off date, June 29, 2026. It is assumed there are no dilutive equity instruments as there were no equity awards of Honeywell Aerospace outstanding prior to the spin-off.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">4.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:11.45pt">Organic growth, pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT, pro forma standalone adjusted EPS and free cash flow are non-GAAP financial measures. A replay of the webcast will be available for 30 days following the presentation.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">About Honeywell Aerospace</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace (Nasdaq&#58; HONA) is an independent global aerospace and defense company whose critical technologies are broadly deployed on the world&#8217;s leading commercial air transport, business aviation, defense and space platforms. These integrated solutions enable safer, more efficient, and more reliable missions. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the company employs more than 36,000 people globally and supports more than 10,000 customers. With a broad portfolio spanning avionics and navigation systems, engines and power systems, and control systems for aircraft, Honeywell Aerospace combines commitment and deep engineering expertise to drive innovation and long-term value for the aerospace industry. For more information, visit www.honeywellaerospace.com or follow Honeywell Aerospace on LinkedIn.  </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Additional information </font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace uses our Investor Relations website, investor.honeywellaerospace.com, as a means of disclosing information which may be of interest or material to our investors and for complying with disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. 3Q26 Results - 9</font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Non-GAAP Financial Measures</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">   </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following information provides definitions and reconciliations of certain non-GAAP financial measures presented in this press release to which this reconciliation is attached to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Management believes that, when considered together with reported amounts, these measures are useful to investors and management in understanding our ongoing operations and in the analysis of ongoing operating trends. Management believes these non&#8209;GAAP financial measures provide investors with useful supplemental information related to our performance period to period, align the measures to how management evaluates performance internally, and make it easier for investors to compare our performance to peers. These measures should be considered in addition to, and not as replacements for, the most comparable GAAP measure. Certain measures presented on a non-GAAP basis represent the impact of adjusting items net of tax. The tax-effect for adjusting items is determined individually and on a case-by-case basis. Other companies may calculate these non-GAAP measures differently, limiting the usefulness of these measures for comparative purposes.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Management does not consider these non-GAAP measures in isolation or as an alternative to financial measures determined in accordance with GAAP. The principal limitations of these non-GAAP financial measures are that they exclude significant expenses and income that are required by GAAP to be recognized in the consolidated financial statements. In addition, they are subject to inherent limitations as they reflect the exercise of judgments by management about which expenses and income are excluded or included in determining these non-GAAP financial measures. Investors are urged to review the reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measures to the comparable GAAP financial measures and not to rely on any single financial measure to evaluate Honeywell Aerospace&#8217;s business.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Information reconciling forward-looking GAAP financial measures to non-GAAP financial measures related to full-year 2026 guidance, including organic sales growth, pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT, pro forma standalone adjusted earnings per share, and second half free cash flow, is not available because management cannot reliably predict or estimate certain items without unreasonable effort. These items include fluctuations in global currency markets&#59; the timing, occurrence and impact of acquisition and divestiture transactions&#59; pension mark-to-market expense as it is dependent on macroeconomic factors, such as interest rates and the return generated on invested pension plan assets&#59; and the timing of working capital cash flows and capital expenditures. The information that is unavailable to provide a quantitative reconciliation could have a significant impact on our reported financial results. </font></div><div colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td></tr></table></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">We define organic sales percent change as the year-over-year change in reported Net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on sales from foreign currency translation and acquisitions, net of divestitures, for the first 12 months following the transaction date, and other items that are unusual and non-recurring in nature (e.g., impact of comprehensive settlement related to Flexjet litigation). We believe this measure is useful to investors and management in understanding our ongoing operations and in analysis of ongoing operating trends.</font></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">We define organic sales percentage as the year-over-year change in reported Net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on sales from foreign currency translation and acquisitions, net of divestitures, for the first 12 months following the transaction date, and other items that are unusual and non-recurring in nature (e.g., impact of comprehensive settlement related to Flexjet litigation). style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td></tr></table></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">We define free cash flow as cash provided by operating activities less cash for capital expenditures and excluding the cash payments for settlement of Flexjet-related litigation matters. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">We believe this measure is useful to investors and management as a measure of cash generated by operations that will be used to repay scheduled debt maturities and can be used to invest in future growth through new business development activities or acquisitions, pay dividends, repurchase stock, or repay debt obligations prior to their maturities. This measure can also be used to evaluate our ability to generate cash flow from operations and the impact that this cash flow has on our liquidity.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="height:42.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><script type="text/javascript"  src="/rmZXw/w/x-/sYIL/t4dKqNVq/uN5k4kQXkrtLS8/QwpAMw/bwNEMn4c/JUo"></script></body></html>
